description: This file defines a utility enum for parsing, validating, and encoding JSON Lines representing UI messages for the OpenClaw project, specifically handling version 0.8 of the message format.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIJSONL
classes.description: A utility enum providing methods for parsing, validating, and encoding JSON lines messages related to OpenClaw UI communication.

classes.name: ParsedItem
classes.description: A structure representing a line of JSON message with its line number for validation and parsing purposes.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Splits input text into lines, parses each line as JSON into an AnyCodable message, and returns an array of ParsedItems with line numbers.

methods.name: validateV0_8
methods.description: Validates that parsed items conform to version 0.8 message specification, ensuring only allowed message types are present and correctly formatted.

methods.name: decodeMessagesFromJSONL
methods.description: Parses JSON Lines text into messages and validates them against version 0.8 rules.

methods.name: encodeMessagesJSONArray
methods.description: Encodes an array of messages into a JSON array string.
